sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Stray Dogs is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good day to you, soldier. Though what's so good about it? You know what a wise man once said? "People were made to torment one another". When I first read that, I thought it couldn't be true. Now I remember those words, and my heart aches. We've got a new gang stirring up trouble in the city. I sent one of my men to talk to them, to try and bring them to their senses. They sent his head back to me. The letter I had asked him to deliver, they stuffed it into his mouth... They're not from around here. All of them came out of USEC, though they've long since turned their backs on their own. They need to be tracked down and wiped out, every last one of them. This is our land. There'll be no more talking with them."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and eliminate Knight (in one raid)
- Locate and eliminate Big Pipe (in one raid)
- Locate and eliminate Birdeye (in one raid)

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Covert Movement skill levels
- Jaeger Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× S I C C organizational pouch
"Don't think about your hands getting bloody again, soldier. Think that you have cleared this land of the wicked."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill Knight, Big Pipe and Birdeye.
